channels.note: The mast pinspots: on while no work performs. Their operation 'presence' keeps them off unless the visitor's car is in the Cube.

performances.caption: A sea at night, full of dinoflagellates that flash blue when the water moves. Nothing lights up unless something moves, and the first thing that moves is you.
performances.note: Sea Light performs only in the sealed Cube: the car at the cube stop, leaves shut, its light at the glimmer, the ceiling iris clamped round the mast head. Publishes 1 while it runs (480 s, fading in 2 s and out 3 s) and 0 otherwise; a second use ("End the piece") ends it, and it ends when the eyes leave the room (|x|, |y| or |z + 22| > 14.000). A running performance is not offered again. The Atrium's rides from cube require it at most 0. It draws only through the panel wall's image; it pushes no sky and lights no piece.
